queries.intent: Read the wiki page of the semantic toolkit module (API outline) — page id from Q001.
Follow edges from the semantic execution module to see what it depends on — page id from Q002.
Public surface and layering of the package: what parrot.semantic exports and whether an 'accounting' subpackage could import siblings.
README layering / positioning statements that a revised FEAT-713 must stay consistent with.
Existing contracts: SemanticQuery, CompiledQuery and friends — names a revised accounting layer must not collide with and could reuse.
How the semantic layer runs SQL today (executor contract, connection resolution, row shape) — basis for the accounting 'database' runtime.
Compiler entry point and engine seam — can an accounting compiler plug in as an engine or must it stay parallel.
Native compiler structure (sqlglot usage, determinism, measure/dimension primitives) — what the generic layer cannot express for accounting.
Existing semantic audit: entry shape, signing, storage contract, fail-closed mode — reuse vs a separate AccountingAuditEntry.
Model loading conventions (models dir, tenant layout, policy side-file) that the accounting model loader should follow or diverge from.
Governed run path (_run_governed) and toolkit construction — where an accounting query would enter if it reused governance.
PBAC gate used by the semantic layer (resource naming, guard class) vs the DatasetPolicyGuard the old spec named.
Policy schema (limits, grants, masks) — whether accounting metrics can be governed by the same policy file.
Packaging test — what test_packaging.py already asserts about the satellite (PEP 420, extras) so the old M1/AC1/AC2 can be retired precisely.
Every in-repo use of duckdb (imports, connect, register) outside tests — existing in-process engine patterns and the read-only governed connection fix.
Where DuckDB appears inside the semantic package and its tests (dialect, fixtures, e2e gate).
Arrow bridges already in core: Table.from_pandas / to_arrow / fetch_arrow_table / register on DuckDB.
Verify pyarrow / duckdb / sqlglot dependency declarations across the workspace (AC17: pyarrow stays core, duckdb only an extra).
Old spec integration points still valid? SQLToolkit.execute_query, database_type, SQLGLOT_DIALECT_MAP.
Old spec integration points still valid? DatasetPolicyGuard.filter_datasets / can_read_dataset and _pctx_var.
Old spec integration points still valid? audit_ledger signers (AbstractKMSSigner and concrete signers).
CLI lazy command registry — is there already a semantic/finance entry; where a 'finance' command would register.
Scheduler seam for a daily live validation: register_object_schedules, @schedule decorator and any call site in the server (old Q11).
Release/CI wiring that the old M1 wanted to create: is ai-parrot-semantic already in release.py, ci.yml, nightly and the root uv sources.
DatasetManager DataFrame storage: direct accessors of entry._df and any DuckDB/Arrow-backed store seam (FEAT-880 U4 moved the DuckDB store here).
Anything named accounting / finance / chart of accounts already in source (not sdd) — prior art or collisions.
MCP local toolkit server config — how the semantic toolkit is registered (pattern for a finance toolkit).
Semantic package tree including examples and docs — what user-facing material exists to extend.
FEAT-880 research already established DatasetManager facts — read its DuckDB-store finding to avoid redoing it.
FEAT-880 finding on the absence of a DuckDB store and on FEAT-713 prior art (F014 per the proposal).
Brainstorm decisions (Option B and the nine resolved Open Questions) — the list to re-validate one by one.
Old spec tail: modules M8-M10, acceptance criteria, codebase contract, risks and open questions (lines 616-1099).
History of the semantic package: when it landed, what changed after the FEAT-704 merge.
How sidemantic was replaced: commits mentioning sidemantic / native compiler (the premise that made FEAT-713 standalone).
History of the FEAT-713 documents themselves and of the FEAT-880 proposal.
Arrow transport work (FEAT-750, PR #1817, PR #1836) — commits and files, to cite the existing Arrow bridge.
Recent DatasetManager history (store / cache / materialize) — collision check for a DuckDB store.
In-flight branches touching semantic / accounting / duckdb / dataset (remote and local) — collision check, incl. FEAT-742 Rust compiler and FEAT-769.
Commits that fixed governed DuckDB connections (read-only) and the DuckDB driver workaround of TASK-4478.

expected_findings: Current shape of ai-parrot-semantic: exports, contracts, compiler engine seam, executor, audit, loader, PBAC, policy
Which old-spec premises are dead (skeleton creation, sidemantic, CI/release wiring) with evidence
Which old-spec integration points still resolve (SQLToolkit, dialect map, guards, signers, CLI, scheduler)
Existing DuckDB and Arrow usage: in the semantic package, in DatasetManager sources, in the REPL Arrow transport
What FEAT-880 expects from this revision (DuckDB-backed dataset store) and how DatasetManager stores frames today
Collision check: in-flight branches / recent commits in semantic and dataset_manager
